observations: The courtyard exterior has dark window groups above pale blue infill, separated by pale structural strips and topped by a pale fascia. Recesses, individual frames and sills are visible as broad features; exact dimensions are estimated.
Courtyard face 2 is the clearest: irregularly spaced window groups and a dark entrance-like feature near its left end. Other outer and courtyard faces are partly obscured by vegetation.

The main cyclotron south face shows window groups along its western half and a reddish opaque eastern end. Its north wall is partly shared with the annex; that shared wall receives no invented openings.
Main cyclotron east and north views are strongly shadowed. Door/window classifications there are provisional.
No provider image pixels are stored or redistributed. Transient images were inspected in memory; only measured survey geometry and manually recorded feature estimates are bundled.
qualification: Source-informed architectural approximation, not current as-built documentation. Window counts in obscured spans, mullions, recess depths, colours, sills and door classifications are explicitly estimated. Preserve all original roofs, courtyard holes, collision files and user blocks; no interiors.
